title: Essentials
description: Vanilla Minecraft boosted by subtle visuals and performance tweaks.
body:
**Essentials** is a refined vanilla modpack built for players who want the purest survival experience only smoother and more immersive. Every addition is carefully chosen to preserve the original feel of Minecraft while elevating the game’s clarity and performance.

This pack enhances the world with subtle visual improvements such as cleaner lighting crisper and more natural environmental details, all without altering the core art style. Performance optimizations ensure faster loading, higher frame rates and a more responsive world, crucial when every heart matters.

There are **no gameplay overhauls, no shortcuts and no safety nets.** Just you, the world and a polished version of vanilla Minecraft that makes the journey smoother and more visually satisfying.

Perfect for players who want survival at its most authentic. **Only better tuned, better looking and better performing.**

**Credits: Vanilla Tweaks: https://vanillatweaks.net/**
